result.analyst_notes: Confident, aspirational first-person plural voice, with hedged phrasing ('we like to think', 'aim to') alongside absolute 'committed to' language. Leads with fuel supply, energy-transition and safety in the headline. Distinctive 'and equation' framing. Workforce, community and dei are thinly addressed. Business-description claims dominate much of the text.
